title: Answer Q-01: warehouse of record and dialect tiers
acceptance: A written, dated answer on which warehouse holds the pilot data and whether anything outside engines.yaml is in play.

title: Capture pre-rollout baselines for success metrics
acceptance: Baseline recorded for data-team ad-hoc hours/week and legacy dashboard usage.

title: ADR-001 deployment target and topology
acceptance: ADR-001 merged: single VM running the same Docker Compose file as the dev loop, one poc environment, Terraform for VM DNS volume and firewall, and a stated growth path to Tier 2 that needs no redesign.

title: ADR-002 warehouse of record and dialect support tiers
acceptance: ADR merged naming the certified serving dialect, the tier model as derived from the conformance suite, and the boundary that admits future dialects.

title: ADR-003 select semantic engine and score dialect matrix
acceptance: ADR-003 merged selecting Cube Core, scored against FR-SEM-01 to FR-SEM-05, the dialect matrix, compile-time security context, and an extension model requiring no fork.

title: ADR-004 spec format and repository layout
acceptance: ADR-004 merged defining file layout, JSON Schema strategy, deterministic serialization and tenancy path separability, derived from the ADR-003 profile. Author-facing spec visibility is explicitly out of scope and left to T-122.

title: ADR-005 front-end stack and chart library
acceptance: ADR-005 merged selecting React plus Vite and Apache ECharts behind a narrow adapter, with a no-browser headless render path, evaluated against chart coverage, cross-filter and drill interactions, server-side rendering for CI screenshots, and WCAG 2.1 AA.

title: ADR-006 backend framework and API style
acceptance: ADR-006 merged selecting TypeScript on Fastify with REST plus JSON Schema, a uniform response envelope, and SSE over externalized job state as the one streaming transport for AI responses.

title: ADR-014 multi-tenancy model and tenant scoping design
acceptance: ADR-014 merged defining tenant scope in artifact registry, cache keys, connections, RLS context, audit log, and repo layout, plus the three mechanical checks that substitute for the deferred NFR-TEN-02 ceremony.

title: Repository scaffold CI pipeline and IaC skeleton
acceptance: A commit to main builds, tests, and deploys to a real staging environment. STARTED 2026-08-10: workspace tree, version pinning, CODEOWNERS and root package.json landed. REMAINING: docker-compose (5 services incl. T-132 Cube env block), apps/api /healthz with the ADR-006 D3 envelope, apps/web trace-id page, Dockerfiles, GitHub Actions, Terraform module.

title: Walking skeleton one model one dashboard one query
acceptance: A hand-written metric change in a file is visible on the deployed dashboard, running against DuckDB with no production warehouse dependency.

title: Define spec JSON Schemas v0 for models metrics dashboards
acceptance: Invalid specs are rejected identically by the app, the CLI, and CI.

title: Deterministic lossless spec serializer
acceptance: Property test proves both idempotence (fmt of fmt equals fmt, byte-for-byte) and semantic preservation (parse of fmt deep-equals parse, comments included), and a check mode fails CI on any non-canonical file under content/.

title: Integrate adopted engine and compile single model single metric to SQL
acceptance: A metric plus a dimension plus a filter compiles through the engine facade to correct SQL and returns a result, with the security context a required parameter of the call.

title: Model and verify join topologies including fan-out and chasm cases
acceptance: Fan-out and chasm topologies return correct values through the adopted engine, and the negative control proves the mechanism is engaged rather than incidentally correct.

title: Model time spine grain rollups and fiscal calendar in the engine
acceptance: The same metric rolls up correctly across day week month quarter year and one fiscal boundary.

title: Model derived ratio and filtered metrics in the engine
acceptance: A ratio metric composed of two measures computes correctly at every supported grain.

title: Model time-offset comparison metrics YoY MoM PTD in the engine
acceptance: YoY and period-to-date variants resolve without a hand-written duplicate metric.

title: Required metadata enforcement in CI
acceptance: A model or metric whose engine metadata block is missing owner or description fails CI.

title: Certification states and deprecation warnings
acceptance: A deprecated metric still resolves, and its certification state and replacement reach the UI through the engine metadata API with no engine patch in the tree.

title: Metric assertion runner golden values
acceptance: A metric whose value drifts outside its declared tolerance fails CI with a readable message.

title: Impact analysis dependency graph
acceptance: Changing a dimension lists every downstream metric and dashboard affected.

title: Golden-file dialect test harness
acceptance: Compiler output is snapshot-tested per supported dialect, extending the conformance suite, and diffs fail the build.

title: Query execution service and connection pooling
acceptance: Compiled SQL executes against a pooled, secrets-managed connection; DuckDB development-tier is the M0 target so no warehouse credentials are required to build or test.

title: Result cache with RLS-safe key strategy
acceptance: Cache hit rate exceeds 85 percent in load test with a written proof that no result crosses a security boundary.

title: Cache invalidation on spec version and data freshness
acceptance: A merged spec change or an upstream data refresh invalidates exactly the affected entries.

title: Query governor timeouts row limits concurrency caps
acceptance: A runaway query is terminated at the configured limit and the user sees a clear message.

title: Query queue with per-user fairness
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. One user issuing heavy queries does not increase p95 latency for others in load test.

title: Artifact publish pipeline merge to serving plane
acceptance: Merging to main publishes an immutable artifact bundle that the serving tier picks up with no downtime.

title: Data freshness signal per source
acceptance: Every chart displays an accurate as-of timestamp for its underlying data.

title: Dashboard spec v0, grid layout and first four chart types
acceptance: A declarative dashboard spec renders line, bar, table and single-value KPI from live query results on a grid layout.

title: Dashboard filters parameters and URL-encoded state
acceptance: A filtered dashboard can be shared by URL and reopens in the same state.

title: Cross-filtering and drill-down
acceptance: Clicking a mark filters sibling charts and drills one level down the hierarchy.

title: Drill-through to row-level detail
acceptance: Drill-through returns only rows the requesting user is permitted to see.

title: Exports CSV XLSX PNG PDF honoring RLS
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. Every export path applies the same security context as the on-screen chart.

title: Conditional formatting and threshold markers
acceptance: A spec-declared threshold renders as a reference line and drives cell formatting.

title: Responsive layout for tablet and phone
acceptance: Dashboards remain readable and usable at tablet width and render read-only single-column on phones.

title: Visual editor with lossless spec round-trip
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. A dashboard edited in the UI produces a minimal, reviewable diff to its spec file.

title: Scheduled delivery and subscriptions
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. A scheduled snapshot is delivered with permissions re-checked at send time.

title: Browse and search catalog
acceptance: Users can find a dashboard by name owner tag certification and recency.

title: Provenance badges and how-is-this-calculated panel
acceptance: Every chart shows its certification state and can reveal its metric definition and generated SQL.

title: Favorites recents and personal collections
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. A user can pin dashboards and return to recently viewed ones.

title: Comments and annotations with mentions
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. A user can comment on a dashboard or data point and mention a colleague.

title: AI service skeleton provider abstraction and spend limits
acceptance: AI calls route through one service with per-user budget enforcement and hard cutoffs.

title: Context builder and retrieval over the semantic layer
acceptance: Given a question, the assembled context reliably contains the relevant models and metrics within the token budget.

title: Ask the data natural language to certified metrics
acceptance: A natural-language question returns an answer plus the metrics filters and SQL used.

title: Refusal path when not answerable from certified metrics
acceptance: An unanswerable question produces an explicit decline and an offer to open a draft, never invented SQL.

title: Build with AI natural language to draft dashboard spec
acceptance: A described dashboard is generated, executed against real data, and shown with its spec diff, streaming progress throughout.

title: Generate validate repair loop for spec output
acceptance: An invalid generated spec is repaired within bounded retries or reported as a failure, never shown broken.

title: Conversation history per draft
acceptance: A user can iteratively refine a draft without restating the original request.

title: New metric proposal detection and flagging
acceptance: A proposal introducing a new metric is labelled and routed to data-team review regardless of author role.

title: AI eval suite and CI regression gate
acceptance: Prompt or model changes that regress the eval set beyond threshold fail CI.

title: Data egress policy enforcement in context builder
acceptance: Columns marked sensitive are provably excluded from any payload sent to the model provider.

title: Prompt injection hardening for warehouse-derived content
acceptance: Adversarial text in a dimension value cannot alter assistant behavior; covered by regression tests.

title: Draft workspace with watermarking and sharing limits
acceptance: Drafts are visibly marked unreviewed and cannot be subscribed to, embedded, or scheduled.

title: Propose action opens a PR via GitHub App with author committer split
acceptance: A user with no git account opens a single atomic multi-file PR, authored to them and committed by the bot, with authoring-mode trailer captured.

title: In-app PR status and bidirectional comment mirroring
acceptance: An author sees review state and replies to reviewer comments without leaving the app.

title: CI gate validate compile assert lint
acceptance: A PR with an invalid or non-compiling spec cannot be merged.

title: CI headless render and screenshot attachment
acceptance: Every PR touching a dashboard gets rendered screenshots posted within the CI time budget.

title: CI metric diff before and after
acceptance: A changed metric definition posts before/after values and percent delta over a sample window.

title: CI query cost estimation and threshold flagging
acceptance: A PR introducing a query above the cost threshold is flagged for reviewer attention.

title: CODEOWNERS routing for review authority
acceptance: Semantic model changes require data-team approval; dashboard-only changes route to the domain owner.

title: Publish on merge with user-visible changelog
acceptance: A merge deploys the artifact and records a changelog entry visible in the app.

title: One-click rollback of a merged artifact
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. An admin restores a prior artifact version without a code deploy.

title: Ephemeral preview environment per PR
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. A reviewer can interact with the proposed dashboard live from a PR link.

title: Audit trail UI derived from git history
acceptance: Any artifact shows who changed what, when, and who approved it.

title: CLI validate compile query and test commands
acceptance: An analytics engineer completes a full authoring cycle with no dependence on the hosted app.

title: Local dev server with hot reload
acceptance: Editing a spec locally updates the previewed dashboard without a restart.

title: Publish JSON Schemas for editor autocomplete
acceptance: VS Code offers completion and inline validation for every spec type.

title: Spec formatter matching visual editor output
acceptance: Hand-edited and UI-edited specs converge on byte-identical output.

title: Bulk refactor tooling for specs
acceptance: Renaming a dimension updates every referencing spec in one reviewed commit.

title: SSO via OIDC or SAML
acceptance: Users authenticate through the corporate IdP with no local password store.

title: Group sync and role model
acceptance: IdP group membership maps to Viewer Builder Reviewer Admin roles automatically.

title: Object-level permissions
acceptance: View edit and manage rights are enforced per dashboard model and connection.

title: Row-level security enforced at compile time
acceptance: Every query path applies the requesting user's row predicate during compilation with no bypass.

title: Column-level security and masking
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. Masked columns stay masked in charts exports drill-through and AI context.

title: Secrets management for warehouse connections
acceptance: No credential is present in the repo, an image, or any client payload.

title: Immutable audit log
acceptance: Auth permission query export and AI events are recorded append-only and queryable.

title: Threat model and penetration test
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. Threat model documented and pen-test findings remediated before GA.

title: Connection management with test and rotate
acceptance: An admin adds, tests, and rotates a warehouse connection per environment.

title: Observability logging tracing and RED metrics
acceptance: Every query is traceable end to end to a user, dashboard, and spec version.

title: Usage analytics for content and cost
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. Admins see most-viewed and unused dashboards plus slowest and costliest queries.

title: Cache administration and scheduled pre-warm
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. An admin inspects hit rate, forces invalidation, and schedules pre-warm per dashboard.

title: Cost attribution and AI spend reporting
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. Warehouse and AI spend are attributable to user and dashboard with alert thresholds.

title: Feature flag infrastructure
acceptance: AI features and new chart types can be enabled per user group without a deploy.

title: Load test to Tier 2 concurrency
acceptance: 500 named / 50 concurrent users sustain p95 warm load under 2.5 seconds.

title: Zero-downtime deploy and rollback runbook
acceptance: A deploy completes with no dropped sessions and a documented rollback path.

title: Legacy content inventory with usage statistics
acceptance: Every legacy report is listed with view counts, used to sequence migration and to select the pilot subject area.

title: Side-by-side validation harness
acceptance: A legacy report and its Tailwind equivalent are diffed automatically as migration evidence.

title: Coexistence directory and authoritative-source signaling
acceptance: During coexistence users can always tell which tool is authoritative for a subject area, and divergent numbers are flagged.

title: Spike assisted conversion of legacy workbooks
acceptance: A timeboxed spike reports whether parsed workbooks yield useful starting-point specs; no importer is committed.

title: Recruit and commit named pilot participants
acceptance: Five to ten named business users and one to two analytics engineers are committed in writing.

title: Backfill metric documentation for the pilot subject area
acceptance: Every model and metric in the pilot area has a description good enough to ground the assistant, bootstrapped from dbt manifest metadata where available.

title: Instrument the thesis metrics
acceptance: PR merge rate and median reviewer time for business-authored PRs are measured automatically.

title: Accessibility audit of the consumption path
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. WCAG 2.1 AA audit completed for viewing and filtering with findings triaged.

title: Agree review SLA with the data team
acceptance: A written median review-turnaround target is owned by the data team's manager.

title: Dialect conformance suite v0 as engine acceptance test
acceptance: Around twenty cases covering four join topologies, the grain matrix and each metric shape pass on the certified dialect and on DuckDB, parameterized by dialect, with negative controls for fan-out and chasm.

title: Seed a second tenant in non-production environments
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC per 08-poc-scope section 6. Non-prod runs two tenants and a test proves no artifact, cache entry, or query result crosses between them.

title: Pluggable warehouse cost model interface
acceptance: Query cost is estimated through an interface that accommodates bytes-scanned, credit, and DBU models without changing callers.

title: Spike serving or extract engine for interactive query latency
acceptance: Timeboxed spike reports, using Tier-2 load-test data, whether result caching alone meets p95 targets or a materialized extract engine is warranted.

title: Coexistence review checkpoint two quarters after GA
acceptance: A dated checkpoint reviews legacy usage decline and decides whether adoption suffices or a forcing function is needed.

title: Enforce single-definition guarantee for metrics
acceptance: CI rejects duplicate metric names and any metric defined outside the semantic layer, including dashboard-local definitions.

title: Degraded mode when AI provider or git host is unavailable
acceptance: With the AI provider and git host both unreachable, viewing filtering and drilling still work and the unavailable features degrade with a clear message.

title: Backup and restore for operational state with RPO RTO validation
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. A restore drill meets RPO of one hour and RTO of four hours and is documented as a runbook.

title: Dependency and container scanning in CI
acceptance: Builds fail on known critical vulnerabilities in dependencies or base images.

title: Per-user warehouse identity passthrough via OAuth
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. Where the warehouse supports it, queries run under the end user identity instead of a shared service account, with cache keys adjusted accordingly.

title: Collect warehouse volumetrics and integration inventory
acceptance: Largest dashboard-backing table size and typical scan volume are measured, and every OPEN row in 07-domain-model section 4 is resolved.

title: Create analytics repo and GitHub App with branch protection
acceptance: App installed with least-privilege permissions, private key in the secret store, and branch protection requiring CODEOWNERS review plus passing checks.

title: Freshness class as a declared spec property
acceptance: Every dashboard declares batch standard or operational, defaulting to standard, and each chart surfaces its class and actual as-of timestamp.

title: Freshness-class-driven cache behaviour
acceptance: Cache TTL, pre-warm, and bypass are derived from the declared class with no author-facing cache configuration, and hit-rate targets are reported per class.

title: Upstream refresh completion signal drives invalidation
acceptance: A dbt run-completion webhook invalidates batch and standard entries, with warehouse metadata polling as documented fallback.

title: Operational freshness class requires data-team approval with cost surfaced
acceptance: Promoting a dashboard to operational routes to data-team review with projected query cost shown in the PR.

title: Declared versus achieved freshness monitoring
acceptance: GA-only, deferred past the POC. Admins see per-dashboard declared class against freshness actually achieved.

title: Review deferral triggers at M2 exit
acceptance: Every trigger in 08-poc-scope section 4 is checked and any that fired is scheduled before the next release.

title: Engine profile lint rejecting non-deterministic model constructs
acceptance: A semantic model using a JavaScript or templated definition, or missing its required metadata block, is rejected by the validator in the app, the CLI and CI alike, and flags any use of a Cloud-gated Cube feature as an error per ADR-003 D1a.

title: Declarative access policies and default-deny on the engine boundary
acceptance: Two security contexts produce two different SQL predicates and two different cache keys, a query with no resolved tenant is rejected, a security context matching no Cube group is rejected rather than served every row, and the engine is unreachable except through the facade.

title: Prove per-request row predicate resolution not per-tenant
acceptance: A test proves two users in the same tenant receive different row sets from one cached-eligible query, and that a per-tenant-only security context fails the test.

title: Spike whether Cube Store is required with pre-aggregations disabled
acceptance: Answered in ADR-003: Cube Store and the refresh worker are not required provided CUBEJS_CACHE_AND_QUEUE_DRIVER is set to memory explicitly, at the cost of a single-replica Cube; the three residual runtime checks are folded into T-116 and T-132.

title: Bootstrap semantic models and metadata from the dbt manifest
acceptance: A dbt manifest generates draft cubes with descriptions and ownership prefilled, reviewed by a human before merge rather than trusted blindly.

title: Wizard-of-oz test of the authoring hypothesis before any code
acceptance: Nine tasks run per 10-wizard-of-oz-protocol.md v2 with outcomes recorded against the codebook, headline reported as merged-and-correct over tasks that produced a PR.

title: Interaction prototype of the three novel surfaces
acceptance: A clickable prototype covers AI authoring, the reviewer evidence view, and the provenance surface, and has been walked through with a real author and a real reviewer.

title: Decide how much of the generated spec a non-technical author sees
acceptance: A written decision on spec visibility for business authors, with reasoning, feeding ADR-005 and the visual editor rather than the file format.

title: Recruit three authors and a reviewer for the wizard-of-oz run
acceptance: Three business users who are the original requesters of their own tasks, plus a reviewer and an auditor drawn from data-team members NOT building Tailwind, and a written reviewer turnaround commitment.

title: Pre-register the wizard-of-oz study
acceptance: Denominator, outcome definitions, planted-error class, adjudicator, and a written merge-rate prediction circulated before task one, recording who is building Tailwind and who is judging the study, confirmed not to overlap.

title: Independent correctness audit of every merged wizard-of-oz artifact
acceptance: An analytics engineer who was not the reviewer audits each merged artifact against its original request and records the result, producing the headline merged-and-correct number.

title: Migrate tickets to GitHub Issues and port the traceability validator to CI
acceptance: Issues carry req_ids and depends_on in a structured block, a GitHub Action enforces all fourteen validator checks against the API, and TICKETS.csv is retired in the same PR that lands the Action.

title: Freeze and tag a semantic model for the pilot subject area
acceptance: One subject area modelled with real descriptions, committed and tagged before the nine tasks are selected, built by someone who is not the wizard-of-oz operator.

title: Remaining v1 chart types
acceptance: Area, scatter, pie/donut, pivot table, sparkline, heatmap and dual-axis combo render from spec.

title: Headless server-side chart rendering path
acceptance: A dashboard spec renders to an image outside a browser session, which is the capability CI screenshots and PDF export both depend on.

title: Tenancy schema guard: tenant_id plus RLS on every tenant-scoped table
acceptance: Adding a tenant-scoped table without tenant_id NOT NULL or without an enabled row-level security policy fails the build, checked against an explicit allow-list of non-tenant tables.

title: Chart accessibility baseline: data-table fallback, safe palette, keyboard traversal
acceptance: Every chart has a keyboard-reachable data-table equivalent, the default palette passes a colourblind simulation, and arrow keys move a focus cursor along a series with an aria-live announcement.

title: Cube Core hardening baseline: pinned version, memory driver, API scopes, group mapping
acceptance: A checked-in Cube config and env file sets the pinned version, memory cache-and-queue driver, restricted API scopes, no Postgres SQL port, and context_to_groups, and a test proves /v1/load answers with no Cube Store container present.
